form.title: Submit a New Citizen Request
form.description: Use this form to register infrastructure issues directly into our live dispatch log. Select an appropriate category, pin down your location or landmark details, and upload an optional photograph to help our municipal response teams review, prioritize, and clear the incident efficiently.
form.description_placeholder: Describe the issue in detail (e.g. pressure drops, exact pipe dimensions, hazard levels)...

feed.title: Live Dispatch Feed
feed.empty_state: Select an entry from the live dispatch streams to inspect deep details.

charts.category_allocation_summary: Breaks down live incident volume by category. Waste management leads with 35% of active reports, followed by roads at 25%, with water and power each contributing 20%.
charts.monthly_inflow_summary: Shows incident reports over January–April. Volume rose from 120 in January to 185 in February, dipped to 140 in March, then climbed to a peak of 210 in April.
charts.turnaround_summary: Compares average resolution times by issue type. Roads average 48 hours, water 72 hours, waste 24 hours, and power repairs are shown at 12 hours.
charts.ward_performance_summary: Shows active request distribution by ward. Ward 7 carries the largest share at 45%, followed by Wards 4 and 9 at 20% each, and Ward 3 at 15%.

metrics.expenditure_ratio_desc: Total expended capital versus treasury balance

dev_tracker.field_summary_title: Field Operations Summary & Milestone Assessment Log
dev_tracker.ward_performance_summary: Displays ward progress percentages using actual completion data. Ward 1 is at 90%, Ward 2 at 75%, Ward 3 at 20%, Ward 4 at 45%, Ward 5 at 60%, Ward 6 at 85%, and Ward 7 at 30%.
dev_tracker.treasury_summary: Displays treasury allocation outcomes for active capital works. 65.2% of the pool is disbursed for active project spend, while 34.8% remains as unspent reserve.
dev_tracker.delivery_track_summary: Tracks active project counts over six quarters. The area curve rises steadily from 12 projects in Q1 2025 to 28 projects by Q2 2026.
dev_tracker.capital_resource_summary: Shows budget allocation share by sector. Roadways lead with 69.0M NPR, water systems follow with 19.5M, health sector projects have 15.2M, and civic buildings hold 11.1M.
